review.note: Release 0.2.1 consumer-integration follow-up: registry candidates remain hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, Ruff 0.17.0 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3, all within existing lower bounds and Python 3.14 support. Reviewed official notes at https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0 and https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/v0.23.3/CHANGELOG.md during this integration. Explicit py314 and selected Ruff rules, standard strict mypy, Node 26.10.0; no changed bounds or pin exceptions. The prior 0.2.0 full gate passed 262 tests and isolated wheel checks. This follow-up only splits one diagnostic string to satisfy consumer E501, without changing its text or runtime behavior; 6 distribution checks and Ruff/mypy/Markdown passed. Fresh 0.2.1 sdist-derived wheel verified all exported components offline. A new clean environment normally resolved the explicit 0.2.1 candidate plus packaging 26.3; package and metadata origins and all original installed wheel members except rewritten RECORD matched the wheel bytes. All six consumer snapshots regenerated from that installed candidate. Windows native remains unexecuted on macOS.
